scope: Frozen SC6 source and CPU evidence only. No public promotion or decoder integration approval.
review_method: Read complete diff against exact 247888 parent.
Read complete focused verifier and actual saved proof report.
Independently hashed final candidate, plan, builder, verifier and both byte-identical author/root CPU reports.
No duplicate full CPU rerun: root independently ran the frozen suite and produced the identical report.

findings.state_and_dispatch: Both actual local W13/W2 scale banks must satisfy PRMT and byte domain 0x40..0x7e. The prepared larger-layout state owns sc6_wgs; SC6 flags enter only its WGS extension key. Tiny remains uncompressed, non-PRMT and unqualified-PRMT fallbacks retain parent paths. Mixed prepared states do not depend on a mutable process-wide encoding flag.
findings.payload_and_barriers: Each global stage is 35840 bytes with four 8960-byte pieces. Both weight expected transaction count and bulk-copy size use WGS_STG. Shared ring slots remain 36864 bytes, leaving 1024 unread padding bytes. X-ring base, X contribution to the joined barrier, participants, phase bits, releases and all three ring slots are unchanged.
findings.arithmetic: Actual native uint32 reconstruction matches parent BF16 scale-pair bits. p.zero is assigned zero by unchanged host source. Codes, KPERM order and every source instruction after scale decoding, including GS2/wait1, NTT1 dual accumulators, WGMMA operand order and finalization, are unchanged.
findings.fallback_alias: Natural-fat aliases can point to WGS entries but are dormant under the unchanged OKC_WGMIN=9 configuration; active define lists contain no override. Sixteen non-WGS preprocessed configurations are identical.
findings.resources: Host diagnostics query both exact BIG pointers with unchanged 576-thread/231168-byte geometry. Attribute/API failures and occupancy below one propagate before the success flag is cached. Register count, local bytes and compiler warnings are informational rather than automatic performance rejection.
findings.cost_hypothesis: Packed weight requests fall by 1/36, or 2.7778%, with unchanged stage count, activation traffic and shared allocation. Added scale load and integer reconstruction can erase the saving. There is no speed or occupancy forecast.

cpu_coverage.actual_full_expert_packing: Complete W13 and W2 dimensions in both code-bit layouts; all code nibbles and reconstructed scale bytes compare with parent. This is coordinate coverage, not 32 independently sampled full expert banks.
negative_controls: Encoding flag leaking across prepared states

accepted_prespecified_gate.official_evidence: Clean setup, five correctness tests, six benchmark cases and six profiles, matching source/evaluator/case identities; inspect SC6 selection and actual compiled admission.
accepted_prespecified_gate.interpretation: Operational consistency screen, not a statistical significance test. A useful standalone result permits separate integration review; it does not automatically establish a leaderboard improvement.

limitations: CPU proof does not compile CUDA or establish GPU memory ordering, tensor-core execution, runtime selection, compiler resources or speed.
Native decoder uses a CPU implementation of byte_perm and unsigned C++ arithmetic; official execution is still required.
Unchanged heavy prepare pack/LUT operations are mocked in the state integration test; actual WGS packing is separately exercised at full expert dimensions.
Root donor arithmetic evidence is independent supporting evidence, not an additional GPU result.
Compiler log truncation must be reported; absence of a warning in retained output is not proof that no warning occurred.
